gaps.lead: The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).

gaps.lead: He had just got home when the power cut happened.
gaps.sentence: ___ home when the power cut happened.

gaps.lead: The doctor said that he should take a complete rest.
gaps.sentence: The doctor advised ___ a complete rest.
gaps.explanation: say + should → advise + object + to-infinitive: advised him to take.

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings in this room,' the guide warned us.
gaps.sentence: The guide warned ___ the paintings in that room.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with warned + object + not to + infinitive.

gaps.lead: 'We are closing the factory,' the board announced.
gaps.sentence: The board announced that ___ the factory.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were closing.

gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.
